spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid_megacap
spec.hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell imbalance (3min trailing, z-scored) predicts 10min continuation in tight-spread mega-cap equities, net of T1 costs; distinct from the momentum signals already falsified in sprint32/34 on illiquid names.
spec.power_argument: 8 mega-cap names, |z|>=2 entry threshold expected to yield ~15-20 qualifying signals/name/day over a ~20-day test window (~1200-1600 raw), capped at 20/day total => n>=300-400. T1 round-trip cost ~4bps. Assuming ~40bps sd of 10min returns, MDE at n=300, alpha=0.05, power=0.8 is ~6.5bps -- above the cost hurdle, so a true null and a true edge are both detectable, unlike sprint33 (n=0, unpowered).

errors: closed-door terms ['taker_imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
